meta.name: data-storytelling
meta.description: 数据科学家与产品经理在向高管汇报或制作投资者演示时，当面临数据枯燥难懂的痛点，使用此技能可套用“Setup-Conflict-Resolution”叙事框架，自动生成结合可视化与业务上下文的洞察报告，让非技术受众秒懂结论并驱动决策。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将枯燥数据转化为驱动决策的清晰叙事
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要把数据结论清晰传达给非技术决策者
copy.tagline_en: Turn dull data into decision-driving stories for non-technical audiences
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to explain data insights to non-technical stakeholders and drive decisions

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会把原始数据按「Setup-Conflict-Resolution」框架组织成故事，产出带标题、图表建议、业务上下文与建议的洞察报告或演示大纲，方便非技术受众看懂结论。
howto.when: 当你向高管汇报、做季度业务复盘或制作投资者演示等场合，提出要把数据讲成故事时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这份流失数据写成一个能打动高管的叙事
给我一条投资者演示的故事线，含标题、图表和建议
say.note: 产出一页式洞察报告模板

say.text: 这些统计太枯燥，改成非技术受众能懂的洞察报告

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude organizes raw data into Setup-Conflict-Resolution narratives and produces insight reports or slide outlines with headlines, chart suggestions, business context and recommendations.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you present analytics to executives, build quarterly business reviews or investor presentations, or ask to turn data into a story.

say_en.text: Turn this churn data into an executive story using Setup-Conflict-Resolution.
say_en.note: Builds a narrative arc with context, conflict and resolution.

say_en.text: Draft an investor storyline with headline, charts and recommendations.
Make these stats an insight report non-technical readers can follow.
say_en.note: Adds business context and calls to action.
